newsitem.title: JAPAN: DuPont-Mitsui polyethylene plant resumes operation.
newsitem.headline: DuPont-Mitsui polyethylene plant resumes operation.

text.p: DuPont-Mitsui Polychemical Co Ltd said on Wednesday its 70,000-tonne-a-year polyethylene plant in western Japan, which had been closed since a fire earlier this month, resumed operations on Tuesday afternoon.
DuPont-Mitsui Polychemical is equally owned by DuPont KK, a Japanese subsidiary of DuPont Co, and Mitsui Petrochemical Industries Ltd.
"Production at the plant had reached full capacity by about 3.00 in the afternoon yesterday," a company spokesman said.
The plant in Hiroshima Prefecture was shut on April 4 after vapourised ethylene released from a reactor caught fire.
